title: Escape Rollout Series
description: A reference-led summer campaign system that locks bright leisure energy and extends it across travel, beverage, and lifestyle variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a bright premium summer world built from citrus color, water reflections, linen texture, and travel polish; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while moving through beach accessories, cold beverage, and linen travel-set variations.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-resort-arrival-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-beach-club-variation, 03-citrus-beverage-variation, 04-linen-travel-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-resort-arrival-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
